{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-wiio","title":"Several replay/response protection tests broken by protect_response refactor","description":"These tests fail after the protect_response refactor:

1. 'delayed_explicit_piv_ordinary_response_ignores_peer_replay_window' - gets Err(Replay) at lib.rs:3208

3. 'oversized_explicit_piv_response_does_not_poison_valid_retry' - gets Err(Replay) at lib.rs:2699

6. 'response_without_piv_requires_requester_identity' - gets Ok(protect) when should get InvalidParam at lib.rs:3269

- protect_response now directly calls fetch_increment() instead of going through reserve_sender, so the response replay window and no-PIV tracking may not be updated correctly
